title: Review
description: This is a JSON schema for the review data structure

filmId.description: Unique identifier of the film for which a review invitation has been issued

reviewerId.description: Unique identifier of the user who has received the review invitation

completed.description: Set to true if the review has been completed, false otherwise

reviewDate.description: The date when the review has been completed by the invited user (YYYY-MM-DD)

rating.description: Non-negative integer number (maximum 10) expressing the rating of the review the user has completed

review.description: A textual description of the review (no longer than 1000 characters)
